content: Add ten repository-scoped Codex expert skills covering the M0100-M0130 CUDA/NVML, PTX/SIMT, MLIR, CPU, Linux driver, vfio-user, vPCI, lifecycle, and Vulkan/SPIR-V boundaries, with indexed routing and trigger evaluations.

Use the standard Codex package contract for every expert: English SKILL.md instructions, agents/openai.yaml metadata, and narrowly routed references. Keep exact versions subordinate to active milestone plans, compiler epoch, and pinned headers.

Keep Von Neumann and Harvard architecture guidance inside cpu-backend-performance because the engineering boundary is memory hierarchy, coherence, NUMA, ordering, MMIO, and DMA rather than a separate repository workstream.

Primary references were selected from NVIDIA CUDA Driver, PTX ISA and NVML documentation; MLIR and LLVM documentation; Linux driver, pinning, DMA, VFIO and PCI documentation; QEMU vfio-user and QMP documentation; Intel and AMD architecture manuals; Arm cache guidance; and the Vulkan specification. Reference files retain links and repository-specific checklists rather than copied specifications.

Implemented ten domain packages with 10 SKILL.md files, 10 agents/openai.yaml files, and 38 focused references. The catalog now indexes 15 unique Active skills and includes seven composition routes. trigger-evals.md records 30 single-skill cases and five multi-skill cases.

All 15 packages passed the bundled Codex skill-creator quick_validate.py. Static checks confirmed unique slugs, matching names, all ten default prompts with exact $skill-id references, fixed Inputs/Routing/Workflow/Output/Verification order, 38 references, 30 single cases and five composition cases. git diff --cached --check and python3 tools/check-agent-records.py . passed.

nix flake check path:. -L evaluated every package/check/devshell/formatter and built the agent-records and entry-points checks; all checks passed. No CTest was required because the content change is confined to agent/.

Content commit a40a47553a9654024e06ac80200d61d1543c563b records the ten expert packages, references, catalog composition routes, and trigger corpus. No runtime API, contract, build graph, durable constraint, decision-ledger row, or milestone status changed.
